info.title: Little Big Brain integrations API
info.description: Hosted integrations for a developer's end customers: one graph per end customer in a developer stack, called from the developer's backend with a stack API key. Generated from apps/saas-api/src/developerContract.ts; see docs/reference/integrations.md, Developer routes.

get.summary: Find the current CDC setup and connection on a graph
get.description: Returns safe setup metadata and configured connection progress for the freshly authenticated stack and graph. No connection id, browser-local state or management credential object is needed. A partially initialized approval remains visible without a capture binding.

get.summary: Read a CDC discovery job and verified source catalog
get.description: Default-off setup on an existing target graph. Returns selected source settings and a verified catalog when ready. Credentials, seals and worker leases are omitted; discovery does not activate capture.

post.summary: Create a sealed CDC discovery job
post.description: Seal credentials, register the existing target graph and persist bounded discovery intent. The dedicated host contacts PostgreSQL. Repeat the same job id, settings and credentials to recover a lost response; different content conflicts. Replacement needs the previous revision and a terminal/expired job. Requires an explicit CDC sealing key. Developer creation and graph limits apply. Needs an active subscription.

Read-only normalization and validation of explicit table, column and foreign-key mappings against the exact discovered catalog. Schema digests and source identity are computed by the data plane. No source connection or activation starts.

post.summary: Approve immutable CDC mapping and activation intent
post.description: Approves the exact job, graph incarnation, ready revision, catalog and mapping. Retry the identical body after response loss, including after discovery expiry. The dedicated host prepares credentials, activates the fresh target and starts the workflow. Approved discovery cannot be replaced or cancelled; capture controls apply once configured. This request never contacts the source or opens credentials. Needs an active subscription.
Fences the exact job and graph incarnation. The host stops the process when it observes cancellation. This does not remove source slots or data. Needs an active subscription.

get.summary: Read experimental CDC progress and health
get.description: Default-off PostgreSQL CDC surface. Returns captured/applied/published positions, current source health and bounded operation history. No source credentials, raw checkpoints or row values are returned.

post.summary: Mute or unmute connection alert notifications
post.description: Version-fenced per-connection notifications preference. Health and active conditions remain visible. Does not start work or require a subscription. Repeat the same revision and value after response loss; refresh status after a conflict.

post.summary: Request a durable CDC control operation
post.description: Records idempotent pause/resume/retire intent before changing capture or apply. A pending operation is recovered by the dedicated host. Retirement requires confirm to repeat the connection id; it stops capture/apply without deleting source slots. Source/configuration replacement fences pending operations. Needs an active subscription.

get.description: The connector catalog: each kind with its credential fields, its settings and its starter ontology. It holds no secret value.

post.description: Seals the credentials, applies the connector's starter (`starter`: `apply` by default), registers the graph with the integration host, creates the connection and asks for its fit, then sends the first sync under the message id `initial-sync` (`start`: true by default). The same request again answers success and queues one first sync. `409 starter_conflict` (with `details.conflicts`) and `409 integration_exists` create nothing. `429 rate_limited` past 20 connections created per stack per hour; `409 integration_limit_reached` past the stack's graph limit (50 by default). Needs an active subscription.

get.summary: List the connections of a graph
get.description: Every connection of the graph with its status, its last run, its totals and its fit. A graph that does not exist has none.
One connection: its status, its settings without the credentials, its current turn and that turn's error, and its fit with the count of open suggestions.

delete.description: Deletes the connection's state, sealed credentials and turn history. The records it wrote stay in the graph. The graph's host registration goes with its last connection. Deleting again answers `deleted: false`.

put.description: Seals the new credentials under the connection's current settings, cancels a failed current turn, then sends `configure` and `check`. Needs an active subscription.

Replaces the connector settings and seals the stored credentials again under them. `409 credentials_required` when the stored credentials do not open under the current settings: replace the credentials first. Needs an active subscription.

post.description: Sends the connection a sync. A request with the same `Idempotency-Key` answers the same turn and sends nothing new. Needs an active subscription.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1 to 100 letters, digits, `_`, `-` or `.`. Without it, every request sends a sync.

post.description: Scheduled syncs and queued work wait until the connection resumes. A paused connection answers as it is.
Queued work and the schedule continue. A connection that is not paused answers as it is. Needs an active subscription.
Deletes every connection of the graph, removes the graph's host registration, then deletes the graph (`POST /v1/graph/delete`) and answers its reclaim passes. Erasing again answers zero counts.

stackApiKey.description: A stack API key, `lbb_sk_…`. The routes ignore cookies and need no CSRF header.

Error401.description: No stack API key, or an unknown, revoked or inactive one (`invalid_api_key`).

Error402.description: The account has no active subscription.

Error403.description: The stack is not enabled for developer access (`integrations_api_disabled`), or it is being deleted (`stack_deletion_pending`).

Error404.description: No such connection in this graph of the key's stack.

Error409.description: The request conflicts with what exists.

Error429.description: Past a rate limit (`rate_limited`): the stack's requests, the stack's connection creations, or keys that failed to authenticate from the client address. `Retry-After` says when to retry.

error.description: Fixed discovery failure code, never source error text.

oneOf.description: Unknown for unlimited/lost slots, never an assumed disk capacity.
Captured initial-snapshot rows; unknown after restoring an already completed snapshot.
Advisory process/cgroup sample; unknown is null. Resets with the reader; not a billing receipt.

everyMs.description: Sync interval. Default one hour; null syncs only on request.
